races.paceDynamic: Plushy and Harry Longabaugh will contest the early lead in this 17-runner handicap, with Plushy showing stronger recent form and likely to dictate from the front. Seven horses wanting prominent positions (Mint Man, Poweracclaim, Apache Star, Whatswrongnow, Art Of Unity, Snowballs, Arctic Steps) will create significant traffic problems turning for home. The honest gallop set by the front two should play to horses that can secure clean runs, but the sheer volume of prominent runners means positioning will be crucial. This race shape favours front runners who can avoid the scrum and hold-up horses with tactical speed who can weave through late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Two Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Plushy and Harry Longabaugh are allowed to build a significant lead without early pressure
scenarios.body: The prominent pack gets tangled up behind them while the leaders maintain their advantage through the final furlong. Clean-running front runners prove superior to those caught in traffic.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pack Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the seven prominent runners close the gap on the leaders turning for home
scenarios.body: The pace becomes truly run and one of the better-rated prominent runners times their challenge perfectly through the melee. Superior class tells among the forward positions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent congestion creates a wall of horses with 2f to run
scenarios.body: A talented hold-up horse with tactical pace finds the gaps that others cannot and storms through late. The honest gallop sets up perfectly for this late thrust.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Special
scenarios.trigger: If both front runners stop quickly due to early overexertion
scenarios.body: The race falls apart completely and a horse from midfield or worse position inherits victory. Form lines become meaningless as positioning luck dominates.

watchPoints.text: Watch for early scrimmaging between Plushy and Harry Longabaugh as both want the lead and neither will give ground easily
Monitor the prominent pack of seven horses for traffic problems turning for home as positioning will determine their chances
Observe if Arctic Steps can secure a better passage than the other prominent runners given his recent winning form
Check if any of the hold-up horses get completely shut out by the wall of prominent runners ahead of them
Watch for signs of rustiness from Harry Longabaugh and Whatswrongnow returning from extended breaks

races.paceDynamic: Bundle Of Interest is the sole confirmed front runner and faces no early pressure, allowing him to dictate terms through comfortable fractions. The prominent runners I Bid You Ajou, Genesis, Pinar Del Rio, and Bint Majestic Roi will track the leader but none are aggressive early types. This sets up a race where the pace will be steady rather than fierce, with Bundle Of Interest able to string the field out before the hold-up horses like Usuario Amigo, Sporting Hero, Inishfallen, and Beauty Queen get their chance. This sustainable pace scenario strongly favours horses that can travel prominently and kick, as the hold-up brigade will have ground to make up when Bundle Of Interest quickens.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Kick Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Bundle Of Interest sets honest but sustainable fractions and the prominent trackers get first run on the field.
scenarios.body: The moderate pace allows Genesis and I Bid You Ajou to sit in perfect striking positions, with Genesis looking particularly dangerous after his recent 6f win on good ground. Their tactical advantage over the hold-up horses proves decisive when Bundle Of Interest inevitably tires.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Bundle Of Interest gets very easy fractions early and has enough left to resist late challengers.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows the leader to build a crucial advantage, and his 183-day break means he's fresh enough to sustain his effort to the line. The hold-up horses leave their runs too late on the testing ground.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses fail to capitalise on their position and the pace becomes truly pedestrian.
scenarios.body: Beauty Queen and Usuario Amigo benefit from Shane Foley and Chris Hayes' big-race experience, timing their challenges perfectly when the early pace-setters hit the wall. The slower tempo allows their superior class to tell.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Closers Swamp Field
scenarios.trigger: If Bundle Of Interest goes too fast early trying to shake off his pursuers.
scenarios.body: The increased tempo sets up perfectly for the hold-up specialists, with Sporting Hero's recent 5f win suggesting he has the pace to pick up the pieces. Multiple horses converge on the line as the early leaders capitulate.

watchPoints.text: Bundle Of Interest must be watched for early alertness after 183 days off and with first-time headgear changes
Genesis's position in the first two furlongs will be crucial as he needs to secure the ideal tracking spot behind Bundle Of Interest
Beauty Queen needs to be settled closer than usual by Shane Foley if the early pace proves as moderate as expected
I Bid You Ajou's jump from the gates is key as he must secure a forward position to capitalise on his prominent running style
Sporting Hero requires strong pace pressure on Bundle Of Interest to set up his hold-up kick but this looks unlikely

races.paceDynamic: Pass Me If You Can will take them along as the sole confirmed front runner, but won't face immediate pressure in a race where 6 horses want prominent positions behind him. The congestion will come from Ocean's Breath, Joyful Tidings, Real Encounter, Dawn Romance, Nakamura and Chicago Pope all fighting for spots 2-4 furlongs out, creating a wall of traffic. This bottleneck 2-3 furlongs from home will leave the hold-up horses - Michael's Well, Gavoo, Midnight Dusk and Tahcawin - with the clearest runs when it matters. The pace dynamic strongly favours hold-up runners who can avoid the mid-race scramble and finish fastest.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack gets bunched up 2-3 furlongs out as expected
scenarios.body: The traffic problems allow patient riders on Michael's Well, Gavoo and Tahcawin to sweep past with clear runs. The pace collapses into a sprint finish that suits closers perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Escapes Traffic
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners gets first run before the bottleneck forms
scenarios.body: Real Encounter or Nakamura breaks clear from the pack before the congestion hits, maintaining momentum to hold off late challengers. Their class tells when getting first use of stamina.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays Clear
scenarios.trigger: If Pass Me If You Can gets an uncontested lead and the pace stays honest
scenarios.body: The leader maintains his advantage as the prominent horses cancel each other out behind, staying clear of the mayhem with sustained galloping. His lone front position becomes the winning tactic.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Speed Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong and takes its toll on closers
scenarios.body: Ocean's Breath or Chicago Pope use their pace to sit handy then quicken before the hold-up horses can get there. The strong gallop finds out the stamina of late runners.

Monitor Pass Me If You Can's fitness after 101 days off as he sets the pace alone
Check if Gavoo handles the return after 176 days as his hold-up style suits perfectly
Watch Real Encounter's positioning early as he needs to avoid the prominent pack congestion
Observe if Michael's Well gets the patient ride his style requires to capitalize on the pace scenario

races.paceDynamic: Eretria, Mixed Feelings, and Ice Dancer will ensure a strong gallop from the gate, with Eretria and Mixed Feelings the most likely to dispute the early lead. Caught U Sleeping will track prominently while the hold-up horses Pollenca, La Fogata, and River Ara settle towards the rear. The sustained pace over this stamina-testing trip will stretch the field and create a honest test. This race shape strongly favours horses with tactical pace who can position handy - prominent runners and those with proven stamina reserves will have the edge over pure hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Sustained
scenarios.trigger: If Eretria and Mixed Feelings engage in a speed duel through the first mile
scenarios.body: The relentless gallop will set up perfectly for Caught U Sleeping to strike from her tracking position, while the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground. This tempo perfectly suits horses with proven stamina who don't need to come from last.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders manages to steal a soft lead without serious pressure
scenarios.body: Eretria or Mixed Feelings could dictate terms and prove hard to peg back over this stamina-sapping distance. The tactical advantage of controlling the pace becomes crucial when the finish arrives.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Hero Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is moderate allowing the back markers to stay in touch
scenarios.body: River Ara or Pollenca could produce their signature finishing kicks from off the pace. The reduced pace scenario gives the hold-up horses a genuine chance to unleash their turn of foot.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders go too fast and completely collapse in the final furlong
scenarios.body: La Fogata could emerge from the pack to capitalize on a pace meltdown having been off since September. This would require a complete tactical breakdown up front with multiple horses stopping.

watchPoints.text: Eretria and Mixed Feelings engaging early - if they go head-to-head from the start it sets up the race perfectly for Caught U Sleeping
River Ara's positioning in the first half-mile - she needs to stay closer than usual given the likely strong pace
Mixed Feelings' jumping from the gates - her natural speed advantage could be negated if she's slow away
La Fogata's fitness after 200 days off - any signs of rustiness will end her chances immediately
Ice Dancer's enthusiasm early - if she tries to match the other leaders she could compromise her chance completely

races.paceDynamic: Galileo Noir will lead unopposed from the start with no other confirmed front runners in this small field. Golddream, Perisher and Marjorie Daw will settle in prominent positions behind, while Pierre Grosse and Freedom And Light are held up. The uncontested leader creates a sustainable tempo that allows prominent runners to track comfortably without excessive early pace pressure. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners who can sit close to Galileo Noir and pounce when the pace quickens, as they avoid the traffic problems that will hinder the hold-up horses in a small field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent trio can track Galileo Noir easily and position well for the straight
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows Golddream, Perisher and Marjorie Daw to be perfectly positioned when the race quickens. Hold-up horses get caught in traffic as the small field spreads across the track.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Leader Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Galileo Noir's uncontested lead proves too valuable and the challengers leave it too late
scenarios.body: The soft early pace gives Galileo Noir enough in reserve to resist the late challenge. Colin Keane times the kick perfectly as the prominent runners hesitate.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Finds Gap
scenarios.trigger: If Pierre Grosse or Freedom And Light find clear daylight in the straight despite the small field
scenarios.body: Shane Foley finds the perfect route on Pierre Grosse who has been running well on good going. The hold-up style works when connections time it right.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Galileo Noir sets the pace too slowly and creates a sprint finish where anything can happen
scenarios.body: The crawling early pace means the entire field arrives together at the business end. Form lines become irrelevant in a bunched finish.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Galileo Noir gets an uncontested lead - Colin Keane may steal this if the pace is too slow
Watch Perisher's headgear and early positioning - the sheepskin cheekpieces suggest behavioural issues
Watch how Shane Foley positions Pierre Grosse early - he needs to be closer than usual in this small field
Watch Freedom And Light's finishing effort - the fading tendency could be fatal in a competitive finish
Watch the early pace - if it's too slow the hold-up horses come right back into contention
